lines.text: The editor has Looks: save an edit as a look, then tap one to apply it to any photo, with Amount up to 200%.
Import .xmp presets from Files or Drive, one or many: only their numbers are kept, under Imported.
Paste a camera recipe's text into Recipes: tone, colour, grain and white balance shift apply; the film name is kept.
Undo in a Photos message now takes a tap (it did not before).
